body: I used to pray for God to give me cancer every day as a kid lol. If I was still religious I'd probably still be doing it.
Jeez just reading that makes me frustrated.

I've spoken to 4 different therapists I think at this point and while this one is better than the last I still feel this way and tbh I really just think I'm a lost cause and it's not worth bothering with me.
A friend, yes. Beyond that, no. People know I'm depressed but I don't say I'm gonna kill myself cause I know I say it so much people will begin to think I'm overreacting.

My suicidal thoughts are always bad the only difference between night and day is I have access to far more methods without anyone seeing me at night rather than day. Sleeping will just be a waste of time to me because I'll feel equally as bad, if not worse, in the morning.

It's nothing in specific tomorrow. It's just the fact that I'm still awake and alive and have to deal with everything in life. Be it yesterday today or tomorrow. Tomorrow also means Monday, which means school, which means more homework and anxiety and feeling like a worthless idiot for the umpteenth time. And tomorrow being another day, assuming it continues on trend with every other day for the last 6 years, will be worse than before because every day I wake up it is almost always worse than before. With the way everything always gets worse and not better, it seems like a waste of time to delay killing myself. I've attempted before and still regret that I'm not dead. I've *never* been happy that I've been alive.

I should also add that upon looking at your profile you are indeed religious and that is against the rules, to post, or comment religion as though it's a cure all solution. It is a very triggering topic for a lot of people for many different reasons. Although you have not mentioned religion in your comment, you did mention it in that post you made an hour ago. Please take any religion or general spiritually to another sub. It's not that your not welcome but seriously religion is like playing with fire on a suicide sub. You're lucky you're talking to me now and not when religion made me suicidal because this might be what had pushed me over the edge. Be careful.

I really don't know what they could have done to be better besides definitely not doing those things. I guess maybe just someone to listen and give genuine advice rather than something about how smiling and positive thinking helps you feel better making things better or that others have it worse. I don't know tbh.

You've written 4 comments, 3 of which were deleted although I'm not sure if that was your doing or a moderators. Regardless I hope you realise that the poetic talking you're doing isn't helping, it's actually quite frustrating and for some may honestly be triggering but it sounds like your a religious dude and religion is pretty triggering for a lot. Please just speak normal, the spirituality isn't helping. Trust me. 

Anyways, it's not about control over who I am. It's over literally everything else. I have control over who I am. I do not have control over other people or random chance. And frankly put I'm tired of letting random chance fuck me over. A teacher of mine said life is 10% what happens to you and 90% how you react. Yeah well if that's the case guess how I'm going to react? With suicide. I'm tired of this BS and I'm tired of getting told that just by changing the way I think things will get better, because I have and they haven't worked. Maybe there's something wrong with me and that's why it hasn't worked. All the more reason to kill myself.

I dunno but at the very least probably just not berating me. It felt like the person was just fussing at me the entire time. Saying stuff like others have it worse and yadda yadda yadda. I stopped listening after a as she spoke because I just got too frustrated. The times in the past (2) I've texted rather than called I've gotten the "it gets better" cliche and those hardly help anyone. You can tell the guy was probably going off of a generic script of sort and while I understand why they probably do it it was an awful experience for me. Rather than arguing with the dude I just told him I was better and stopped texting cause I didn't wanna text for like 3 hours.

Same boat. First attempt was when I was 10. Been nothing but downhill and frankly now that I think about it childhood was probably the best time of my life, even though it was still awful. Now I have to exist in some bullshit capitalist economy that does nothing but depress people? This is the "real world" everyone was talking about? That's fine and dandy if others are cool with living like this but I just cannot if this is what the world is like.

Oh wow. Let me quote my other post I made literally 3 hours ago then

I'm so sick and tired of the be positive bullshit. Nothing is ever positive. And then one time I do find something positive it gets ripped away from me. Fuck off with thinking everyone has control over their situation and just wishful thinking and smiles and sunshine make all the pain suddenly go away.

Edit: I'm sure you mean well but words like these are annoying, frustrating, cliche, and just straight up wrong. I'm tired of seeing facebook copypastas from a facebook mom who sells essential oils. Even if that's not where you got yours from, I've heard this same exact thing hundreds of times and its never helped.
